_comment: Candidate creature coats, OFF by default (scripts/creatures/creature_body.gd _apply_coat_flags). An enabled flag maps an ordinary coat's live albedo path to a graded file; an emission slot carrying the same image follows it; shiny bodies are untouched. The GPU judges an arm by flipping enabled; the graded files need an import like any new texture.

creatures_f36_coat_lift._why: CREATURES-F36 (31 Oct). GPU ROSTER-1 High (coordinator): cindercub 7.13, duskhush 6.77 and ashtusk 6.68 want a value lift and rim; GPU CO12 (31 Oct): thundertunnel 6.49 / 6.50 is still 'a dark mound with no readable face' after its first lift. Grades from tools/art_pipeline/grade_coat_value.py.

creatures_f36_coat_lift_2._why: CREATURES-F36 batch 2 (31 Oct). GPU roster 24 Oct: shadelet 6.29 'near-black, no rim light; silhouette dissolves', stormtrail 5.98 'flat black placeholder dog'; CO12 31 Oct: nightburrow 6.67 'coat noisy and speckled'. Same grade as creatures_f36_coat_lift (tools/art_pipeline/grade_coat_value.py), gentler on the night and storm variants.

creatures_f36_matte_finish._why: CREATURES-F36 (31 Oct). GPU roster 24 Oct off-style materials (R4): skyrill 6.33 'chrome-mirror skin', voltarach 6.87 'chrome-gold statue shader', sparkit 6.28 'flat mustard material', reedwing 6.78 'decal-like', cragclaw 6.40 'plasticky salmon skin'. Probed live materials: skyrill, sparkit and reedwing render metallic 1.0 over their metallic maps; voltarach takes its gloss from its roughness map. Matte: metallic off, a constant fur/hide roughness, lower specular.

remake_owner1101_glow_read._why: CAUSE-REMAKES (1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged). GPU creature stage (1 Nov, three judges): the owner rule's fantasy element (glowing eyes plus element lines, veins or spots) does not read at gameplay distance on the remakes; only Brooktail's aqua spots showed (its map covers 2.8% of the texture at mean 0.76; Terrapup's 0.02%, eye dots only; Bramblebun's veins mean 0.52). One shared pass for all 46 remakes with a glow mask: the existing arc_emission mask (same hue choices) lit fully, a small halo inside the UV island for eye-only and thin-line masks (none above 2% coverage, so spots never become a body glow), purer element hue so Compatibility's LDR clip keeps the colour (warm glows held at hue 28+), emission energy 2.6 / 2.0 / 1.4 by coverage under 0.15% / under 2% / above. Bramblebun's core is rebuilt from its crevice veins (hue 112-155, about 3%; leaves stay unlit) at 2.0. Solmane and Tuskroot have no glow map (none in the concept / natural amber eyes). Real emission, not bloom: it reads with glow off. Script tools/art_pipeline/remake_owner1101_finish.py glow.

remake_owner1101_plate_blend._why: CAUSE-REMAKES (1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged). GPU creature stage: Terrapup's 'evenly tiled green plates look stuck on, generated'; Bramblebun's bark plates read 'like a plaster cast'. Terrapup: pale bevel rims flattened, stone tone varies between warm stone and moss across the body, moss in the crevices between tiles, plate edges darken into moss and dirt where they meet the coat. Bramblebun: grainy pale bark plates (region vote on carved-grain contrast, so the soft white belly and inner-ear fur stay) go warm brown (hue 28-36, saturation under 0.5, clear of Team Tether red) with grain kept, and moss creeps in from the veins and leaves. Eyes, veins and fur keep their pixels; mesh and UVs untouched. Script tools/art_pipeline/remake_owner1101_finish.py plate.

remake_owner1101_dark_lift._why: CAUSE-REMAKES (1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged). GPU creature stage: dark remake bodies (Brooktail, the black river otter; Voltarach) sink into dark ground. The same value lift as creatures_f36_coat_lift (dark low-saturation texels x1.35-1.4 plus 0.03, feathered; eyes, mouth line and the saturated aqua spots and blue sparks keep their pixels), gentle enough to keep the black identity. Pairs with remake_owner1101_glow_read (its emission map applies over the lifted albedo). Script tools/art_pipeline/grade_coat_value.py brooktail_owner1101 voltarach_owner1101. Visual lane v1/b24 (4 Nov, CPU stage frames, three code-blind judges, calibrate.py r 0.93): Voltarach 5.28 -> 6.04 (+0.76, all three judges higher), Brooktail 6.18 -> 6.28 (+0.10, two higher, one tie); ships ON (owner 4 Nov: every judged gain ships ON; a GPU High pass still closes the rows).

creatures_ralph_cliffspike_bands._why: Cliffspike r1 judged on CPU (three code-blind judges, anchors, calibrate.py): shipped remake 5.53 -> 6.49 mapped, target 5.80. Creatures-ralph (2 Nov 2026), batch-4 GPU judges on the Cliffspike remake: 'grey porcupine hides its face under the quills', one pale value over body and quills. Banded quills as on a real porcupine: dark warm base tone on the body and quill roots grading to pale cream tips by 3D distance from the body centre, a lighter warm-grey face below the quill line, glowing eyes and lines kept (tools/art_pipeline/grade_quill_bands.py cliffspike/candidate_owner1101). Mesh weight fix for the hit-react sheet ships in the GLB itself (tools/art_pipeline/relax_stretched_weights.py).

creatures_ralph_mangrove_monitor_scales._why: Creatures-ralph (2 Nov 2026), attempt 2 on the Mangrove Monitor remake (batch-4 GPU: 'plain, smooth, rubbery green monitor', 'no elemental trait'). The shipped olive colour kept (r2: a lighter regrade read more rubbery), scale-pattern contrast x1.6 a step darker (data/creatures/remake_grades.json), a matte finish, and the thin aqua lines lit through the glow_read mask at 2.2. r6: 5.30 -> 5.17 mapped, no gain; stays OFF (second failed approach, parked).

creatures_ralph_cragclaw_body_lift._why: Creatures-ralph (2 Nov 2026), attempt 2 on the Cragclaw remake (batch-4 GPU: 'muddled dark mass whose body hides under the shell, face does not read'). Legs, claws, underside and face lift to a lighter sand-slate below the shell line, the mossy shell keeps its own pixels (data/creatures/remake_grades.json cragclaw), and the blue lines glow through the glow_read mask at 2.4. r6: 5.05 -> 5.52 mapped, short of the 5.90 target; stays OFF (the pale body reads unpainted).

creatures_ralph_cannonback_moss._why: Cannonback r6 judged on CPU: shipped remake 5.33 -> 6.22 mapped, target 5.88. Creatures-ralph (2 Nov 2026), attempt 2 on the Cannonback remake (batch-4 GPU: 'tank-like cartoon turtle with cannon studs reads as toy styling'). Barrels and shell top go to the same dark mossy basalt as the scutes so they read as rock knobs, darker moss-brown scutes, olive-grey skin (data/creatures/remake_grades.json cannonback), matte, aqua cracks low at 1.2.

creatures_ralph_cragclaw_body_mid._why: Creatures-ralph (2 Nov 2026), Cragclaw attempt 3 (batch-4 GPU: 'muddled dark mass whose body hides under the shell, face does not read'; r6: a pale lift read 'unpainted clay'). Body below the shell in a mid-value slate-olive of the shell's hue family, face a step lighter (data/creatures/remake_grades.json cragclaw), blue lines lit through glow_read at 2.4. Pairs with the scale flag creatures_ralph_cragclaw_presence. r7 CPU three-judge A/B: 5.39 -> 6.34 mapped (target 5.90), ON.

creatures_ralph_burrowback_plates._why: Creatures-ralph (2 Nov 2026), Burrowback remake (r5: 6.71 against the installed 6.80; judges: the back plates tile like a turtle shell). Spine plates get a model-space value jitter in warm stone-moss so neighbouring plates differ; the coat keeps its source colour (data/creatures/remake_grades.json burrowback). Applies only while remake_owner1101_burrowback is ON. r7: remake+plates 6.34 against the installed 6.97 mapped; stays OFF with the remake HELD (second approach, parked).

Applies only while remake_owner1101_trailpup is ON. r7: remake+coyote 6.70 against the installed 7.37 mapped; stays OFF with the remake HELD (second approach, parked).

creatures_ralph_meadowhart_warm._why: Creatures-ralph (2 Nov 2026), Meadowhart remake (GPU batch 5: installed 7.67 -> remake 6.91; judges: 'pale, thin vine-wrapped deer loses value contrast', 'mottled root-veined hide muddies the read'). The hit react's neck and head swing are reduced in the GLB (neck x0.45, head x0.6) so the head no longer collapses into a stoop. r8 CPU three-judge A/B: shipped remake 6.12 -> 6.80 mapped (+0.68), 0.10 short of the 6.9 target, so OFF pending the coordinator (it is a clear gain over the live remake); r9 attempt 2 gained nothing.
creatures_ralph_meadowhart_warm._why_on: ON (owner 4 Nov 2026: land every judged improvement): r8 CPU three-judge A/B shipped remake 6.12 -> 6.80 mapped.
